title: Refund policy
text: Delivered orders can be refunded within 30 days of delivery. Refunds go back to the original payment method and appear in 5-7 business days. Refunds over $100 are reviewed by our team within 24 hours.

title: Returns
text: Shipped orders can't be cancelled, but you can return any item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Start a return from Orders > Return item.

title: Cancelling an order
text: Orders can be cancelled free of charge while they are still processing. Once an order ships it can no longer be cancelled.

title: Shipping times
text: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days after dispatch. Express takes 1-2 business days. You'll get a tracking link by email when your order ships.

title: Password reset
text: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page, or ask support to send a reset link. Reset links expire after 1 hour.

title: Warranty
text: All electronics carry a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered.

title: International shipping
text: We ship to 40 countries. Import duties are paid by the recipient.
